area_note: Island-wide: the CBD and Marina Bay, the Singapore Sports Hub at Kallang, East Coast Park, and heartland stadiums from Jurong to Punggol
intro: Most Singapore group runs happen on weekday evenings from about 6.30pm to 7.45pm, after office hours, or early on weekend mornings between about 6am and 7.30am. Common meeting points are Raffles Place and Marina Bay in the CBD, the 100PLUS Promenade and The Kallang at the Singapore Sports Hub, Parkland Green in East Coast Park, Jurong Lake Gardens, and public stadium tracks such as Bishan, Bukit Gombak and MOE (Evans Road) for interval work. Most community clubs and brand clubs are free to join, and several hash groups run social trails on weekday evenings.

clubs.name: Running Department

meets.where: Rotates: UOB Plaza, Raffles Place; Great Eastern Promenade, The Kallang; or Decathlon (Kallang) car park
Parkland Green, East Coast Park

clubs.who: All levels; Saturday pop-up runs are women-only
clubs.description: A volunteer-run community founded in 2013 that holds free, no-frills weekly runs (base, tempo, strength and hill sessions over 5 km or 10 km) and publishes its schedule at the start of each month. Runners register once through its Dept. Access platform; only runs marked with an asterisk need sign-up.
clubs.active_evidence: October 2026 run schedule (correct as of 2 Oct 2026) on its website

clubs.name: Lion City Road Runners (LCRR)

Sessions are run in loops of about 6 km, with nine pace groups from 4:59 to 7:49 min/km, and include bag drop and hydration. You do not need to belong to a club to join.
clubs.active_evidence: Session #11 listed for 31 Oct 2026 on the race's official site; details confirmed by the race organiser by email, 1 Oct 2026

Bukit Gombak Stadium

clubs.who: All ages and abilities

The schedule above is from Shopee's March 2026 round-up, and the marathon's 2026 listing shows runs on Mondays, Wednesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays.

18 Robinson Road

meets.where: Rotates: Parkland Green, East Coast Park, or West Coast Park

clubs.who: Beginners to experienced runners, with pace groups at every session; joining is by referral, and members commit to running 50 km a month

clubs.who: All abilities; membership is capped at 300 active members, with a wait list

clubs.active_evidence: Instagram posts dated 20 Oct to 1 Nov 2026; Annual Membership 2026-27 page on its website

clubs.name: Singapore Shufflers

meets.where: Home of Athletics
MOE Evans Road Track or Bishan Stadium
Bukit Brown

clubs.who: Committed intermediate to advanced runners looking for structured, performance-based training. Spaces are limited, so email the club about joining first
clubs.description: A performance road-running club whose sessions are led by World Athletics certified coaches. Runners are split into ability-based groups and follow periodised programmes aimed at major races and key periods of the year. The club says it is the top-ranked road running club in Singapore, with age-category wins and podium places in Berlin, Valencia, Gold Coast, Wuxi, Melbourne, Seoul and more.
clubs.active_evidence: 2026 club 5K handicap result and a privacy policy updated 15 Aug 2026 on its website; schedule and description confirmed by the club by email, 2 Oct 2026

clubs.name: Singapore Frontrunners

meets.where: Varies each week (e.g. Stadium MRT Exit A for a Geylang River route, 5 Nov 2026)

clubs.who: Open to all; routes usually offer a shorter and a longer option, and walkers are welcome on some loops
clubs.description: A club founded in 2014 as part of International Front Runners, the worldwide network of LGBT running clubs, and open to everyone. Runs are followed by a meal together nearby. Each week's routes, meeting points and run captains are posted on a public run sheet linked from its Instagram.
clubs.active_evidence: Thursday run listed for 5 Nov 2026 on its public run sheet; Instagram posts to 1 Nov 2026

clubs.name: Runninghour

meets.where: Various places around Singapore
Various places around Singapore

It also holds Wednesday stretch sessions at Tanjong Rhu and Thursday fitness sessions near Stadium MRT, and organises the annual Run For Inclusion.
clubs.active_evidence: Run For Inclusion 2026, rescheduled to 23 Jan 2027, announced on its website; City Nomads article on its weekly sessions and the event, 25 Aug 2026

clubs.who: All levels

clubs.name: Kampong Hash House Harriers

clubs.name: Mountain Goat Running Group (MGRG)

clubs.description: A volunteer-run trail running group that organises the Ultra Trail Singapore (UTSG) races and the MG Challenge. Before UTSG it holds weekend familiarisation runs on the race routes (Saturdays from Bukit Timah, Sundays from Labrador Park or Mount Faber, 7am), and FitnessInSingapore lists weekend sessions on roads, hills and trails.

coaches.active_evidence: Blog posts dated to 26 Oct 2026 on fitfamco.com/resource; running coaching page live
